data.name: Alhusain
data.long_meaning: In the name Al-Husain, Al is a prefix denoting 'the' in Arabic, and Husain is the name itself. Husain means 'the well-satisfied one'. This name is a reference to Imam Husain ibn Ali, the grandson of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh), who was known for his piety, courage, and unwavering commitment to Islam.
